result.issue: For Cedar Lantern’s library delivery trial, which neighborhoods are included, what is the pickup window, and how will residents report a missed delivery?

questions.text: For Cedar Lantern’s library delivery trial, which neighborhoods are included, what is the pickup window, and how will residents report a missed delivery?

answers.text: The library delivery trial covers Maple End and West Quay. During the trial, the pickup window is Tuesday from 2 to 5 p.m. Residents report a missed library delivery by leaving a message on the trial voicemail line. Staff review messages the following morning. The office keeps a separate log for day-to-day questions. Each entry contains the date received and a brief description, followed by the initials of the person who filed it.

The library delivery trial covers Maple End and West Quay. Other
neighborhoods remain outside this trial even if a rider passes through them.

To prepare the shared working folder, staff place the latest notes beside the intake
sheet and retain the previous copy in the archive. A coordinator checks the file
name and the date before the next handoff. If a document is missing, the team
records that gap and asks for the original; a replacement is not assumed to exist.

evidence.heading: Cedar working note 2
evidence.content:
During the trial, the pickup window is Tuesday from 2 to 5 p.m. The library
desk keeps any uncollected parcels until the next working day.

For routine handoffs, open the checklist, mark the items already reviewed, and
leave the remainder for the next shift. The checklist is a record of work in
progress, not an authorization to change the underlying arrangement. Staff can
add a short note when a handoff crosses a weekend or a public holiday.
